environment: Stopped isolated local run; volumes preserved. Returned IDs belong only to that run.
qualification: Only the listed input/profile/behavior was observed at the served commit; not every branch or dataset accepted by an operation.

POST /api/v1/cases.scope: Create a workspace using the actual USGS document title.

POST /api/v1/cases/{caseId}/sources.scope: Retain plan-pdf-v1, queue inspection and replay the same idempotency key without duplicate source/jobs.

GET /api/v1/cases/{caseId}.scope: Read persisted source inspection and failed/succeeded canonical job history; PDF remains needs_input with no geometry.

POST /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/retry.scope: Recover after an owned processor outage with the same original and input fingerprint.

GET /api/v1/sources/{sourceId}/file.scope: Verify unchanged original hash/size, private headers and remote-origin denial for both inputs.

POST /api/v1/import-packages/inspect.scope: Inspect the unchanged single-feature official NYC GeoJSON.

POST /api/v1/import-packages.scope: Synchronously import the inspected multipart GeoJSON with its native key and unknown geometry role.

GET /api/v1/import-packages/{packageId}.scope: Read the persisted package and candidate/source-evidence binding.

GET /api/v1/areas/{areaId}/context.scope: Read the same persisted package and candidate in its area context.
